name: 1S LiPo pouch cell, about 1000 mAh, with protection board
blurb: A rechargeable single-cell 3.7 V lithium-polymer battery with a small protection board; size is per project, this definition uses a typical 503450 cell (5.0 x 34 x 50 mm).

pins.note: Red lead. 3.0 to 4.2 V depending on charge, not a regulated rail. Never short it; the protection board is a last resort, not a fuse you can rely on. Check the JST plug polarity against your charger: it is not standardised.

verify: Cell size is per project: the code 503450 means about 5.0 mm thick, 34 mm wide, 50 mm long, but real cells are up to 0.5 to 1 mm larger and swell with age. Measure the actual cell thickness, width and length, leave 1 mm or more clearance for swelling, and check capacity, discharge rating (the 1000 mA supply limit is a conservative assumption, not a datasheet value), connector type and polarity. The lead exit position and spacing are schematic. Confirm a protection board is actually fitted.
sources: No datasheet opened. 503450 is the industry size code for a pouch cell 5.0 mm thick, 34 mm wide and 50 mm long; this is a typical size, not a specific product.
